name: ladi-cracker
brief: One single small Indian Diwali ladi firecracker (one cracker from a string of chained crackers), standing upright, front view. A short fat cylinder of glossy red paper, about twice as tall as wide, crimped flat ends, one narrow marigold-gold paper band and one thin green paper band wrapped around the middle, a tiny dark printed star. A short twisted grey-brown fuse (wick) sticks straight up out of the top centre, about a third of the tube's height. Deep aubergine outline, two or three hard shade steps, small paper-crease highlight. Unlit: no flame, spark, smoke, glow or lettering. Nothing else in the image.
subject: prop
